posts.text: image 982×1098 315 KB Tube Investments of India acquires additional 2.69% stake in Shanthi Gears, on 21 Aug’26 for Rs. 77.49 Cr. This increases TII’s total shareholding in SGL from 70.46% to 73.16%. Company’s ordebook is at all time high with opportunities in Defence, Aerospace and Physical AI This is what Shanthi gears Annual Report says on R&D and such investments. More than 1% of revenue for R&D, focus on import substitution and defence sector

posts.text: Muted Q1FY27 from Shanthi. Unexecuted orderbook is at a high of 378cr. Most concerning thing is multiple high level exits in recent times. Just recently Head - Strategic Sourcing has resigned.
